basis_px.description: Committed main-axis basis for a docked Home surface, or the normalized basis used by the current host.

cross_basis_px.description: Committed cross-axis basis. For dock_top and dock_bottom this is the shared row-dock track thickness; pre-field records migrate it from basis_px before canonical validation.

preset_id.description: Optional committed semantic size preset used to restore adaptive Home surface content. It is absent until a curated preset is selected and never contains preview state.

flex_weight.description: Committed proportional main-axis weight used when the host distributes remaining space.

min_width_px.description: Committed minimum rendered width for the surface.

min_height_px.description: Committed minimum rendered height for the surface.

size.description: Settled Home surface sizing only. Pointer-preview dimensions, ghosts, placeholders, and animation state are not schema fields.
